item.title: Correction · Block 2: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "That tieback permit's cost was revised to…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "That tieback permit's cost was revised to $297,000." says the permit's cost was revised. DataSF DBI Building Permits, permit 202502100035: "estimated_cost":"297000.0","revised_cost":"297000.0". The two fields are equal, so the figure is the permit's declared valuation, not a revised or actual construction cost. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=202502100035.

item.title: Correction · Block 2: The $575 million in bonds is a not-to-exceed amount in IBank's April 2025…
item.description: The $575 million in bonds is a not-to-exceed amount in IBank's April 2025 staff report, with an expected closing date of May 28, 2025; no closing document has been found. Sources name different general contractors (Webcor Builders per SF YIMBY; DPR Associate Capital per IBank's 2025 report). The UC Regents had the project before them as item F5 on September 18, 2024; the outcome is not confirmed. The Regents item says all lease terms are expected to be 30 years. Source: https://ibank.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/4a-Campus-Facilities-Staff-Report.pdf ; https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept24/f5.pdf ; https://www.bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/capital-markets/ucsf-charges-up-half-billion-dollar-300000-square-foot-power-station-project-129349 ; https://sfyimby.com/2026/02/excavation-work-underway-for-potrero-power-station-block-2-san-francisco.html.

item.title: Correction · Block 2: The building's floor-area range gave about 278,000 sq ft as if a source…
item.description: The building's floor-area range gave about 278,000 sq ft as if a source stated it. It is Pier & Point's sum of the Design Review approval's three figures (685 + 89,476 + 187,819 = 277,980 sq ft), and the page now says so. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · Block 2: Potrero Block 2's $575 million is now shown as a ceiling: California IBank's…
item.description: Potrero Block 2's $575 million is now shown as a ceiling: California IBank's staff report asked its board to authorize bonds 'not to exceed' that amount, to be sold to underwriters led by Goldman Sachs. It is not a closed financing and not a construction cost. Source: California IBank staff report, Campus Facilities Improvement Association, board meeting 2025-04-23 (ibank.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/4a-Campus-Facilities-Staff-Report.pdf).
item.source: California IBank staff report, Campus Facilities Improvement Association, board meeting 2025-04-23 (ibank.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/4a-Campus-Facilities-Staff-Report.pdf)

item.title: Correction · Block 2: Block 2 no longer shows a single expected completion year: SF YIMBY…
item.description: Block 2 no longer shows a single expected completion year: SF YIMBY (February 2026) says overall completion by 2030, the SF Chronicle (July 2026) says a phased opening from 2028, and Bisnow (May 2025) said construction would be completed by 2029. The February 2026 entry now reads as a report that foundation work was underway, and notes that the article dates the start of construction to August 2025. Source: SF YIMBY, 2026-02-09 (sfyimby.com/2026/02/excavation-work-underway-for-potrero-power-station-block-2-san-francisco.html); SF Chronicle, 2026-07-29 (sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/one-s-f-s-biggest-developments-changing-plans-22365461.php); Bisnow, 2025-05-13.

item.title: Correction · Block 2: Block 2 (UCSF): overall completion is now shown as expected by 2030 per the…
item.description: Block 2 (UCSF): overall completion is now shown as expected by 2030 per the project team (SF YIMBY, Feb 2026), replacing a 'late 2028' date the article does not give. The address is stated as 420 23rd Street, with 249 Craig Ln as the Assessor's address, and the distance to the unrelated parcel it was once matched to is about 125 m, not 250 m. Five DBI permit dates that had recorded the issue date as the filing or completion date were corrected. The financing structure is described as the plan Bisnow reported in May 2025 ($575 million, 'more than half a billion dollars'), the Regents' CEQA document is described as findings put before the Regents, since it does not record adoption, and several citations now point to the article or dataset that states the claim. Source: SF YIMBY, 2026-02-09 (https://sfyimby.com/2026/02/excavation-work-underway-for-potrero-power-station-block-2-san-francisco.html); SF Planning, Block 2 Design Review memo, 2026-01-27, approved 2026-02-03 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); DataSF Building Permits (DBI permit records); Bisnow, 2025-05-13 (https://www.bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/capital-markets/ucsf-charges-up-half-billion-dollar-300000-square-foot-power-station-project-129349); The Regents of the University of California, CEQA findings, Sep 2024 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept24/f5attach6.pdf).
item.source: SF YIMBY, 2026-02-09 (https://sfyimby.com/2026/02/excavation-work-underway-for-potrero-power-station-block-2-san-francisco.html); SF Planning, Block 2 Design Review memo, 2026-01-27, approved 2026-02-03 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); DataSF Building Permits (DBI permit records); Bisnow, 2025-05-13 (https://www.bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/capital-markets/ucsf-charges-up-half-billion-dollar-300000-square-foot-power-station-project-129349); The Regents of the University of California, CEQA findings, Sep 2024 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept24/f5attach6.pdf)

item.description: Block 2 · UCSF moved to its real parcel at 249 Craig Ln (4175027; the Planning Department's design-review memo gives Block/Lot 4175/027). item.title: Milestone · Block 2: Bisnow reports UCSF's announced financing plan ("selling $575M… (May 13, 2025)
item.description: Bisnow reports UCSF's announced financing plan ("selling $575M in bonds"): California Infrastructure and Economic Development Bank (IBank) selling "more than half a billion dollars in tax-exempt bonds to Goldman Sachs" and lending the proceeds to nonprofit Campus Facilities Improvement Association, which would ground-lease from the UC Regents and sublease to Associate Capital. The date is Bisnow's publication date; IBank's board authorization was requested for April 23, 2025, and its staff report sets $575,000,000 as a "not to exceed" amount (estimated bond proceeds $532,185,000) (May 13, 2025). Source: Bisnow San Francisco, 2025-05-13.
